description: This pie chart illustrates the distribution of various emotional categories, likely from a speech dataset used for evaluating speaker anonymization. The chart is divided into six distinct slices. The largest segment is light blue, labeled "Frustration," accounting for 25.1% of the total. This is followed by a purple slice labeled "Neutral" at 23.1%. The remaining slices include a yellow segment labeled "Anger" at 14.9%, an orange segment at 14.7% (for which the external label is cut off or not visible), a red segment labeled "Excitement" at 14.1%, and the smallest segment, which is medium blue and labeled "Happiness" at 8.1%. The chart does not utilize a separate legend; rather, the category labels are placed outside the perimeter adjacent to their respective slices, while the exact percentage values are printed directly inside each slice. There are no visually emphasized, exploded, or offset slices, and the segments are not arranged in a strict ascending or descending order by size.
